scenario_probe.method: Flask in-process test client and scenario-state reads
scenario_probe.source:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "sim" / "modbus_sim"))
import scenario_api, scenario_state
client = scenario_api.app.test_client()
observations = []
for name, expected_health, expected_override in [
    ("NORMAL", "GREEN", (2, 0)),
    ("QUALITY_HOLD_QUENCH", "AMBER", (3, 311)),
]:
    response = client.post("/scenario", json={"scenario": name})
    body = response.get_json()
    observed = scenario_state.get_override("quench-01")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert body["scenario"] == name and body["health"] == expected_health
    assert observed == expected_override
    readback = client.get("/scenario").get_json()
    assert readback["scenario"] == name
    observations.append({"requested": name, "health": body["health"], "quench_override": list(observed), "http_status": response.status_code, "readback": readback["scenario"]})
invalid = client.post("/scenario", json={"scenario": "INVALID_CP1_SCENARIO"})
assert invalid.status_code == 422
assert scenario_state.get_scenario() == "QUALITY_HOLD_QUENCH"
observations.append({"requested": "INVALID_CP1_SCENARIO", "http_status": invalid.status_code, "state_preserved": True})
response = client.post("/scenario", json={"scenario": "NORMAL"})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.get_json()["health"] == "GREEN"
assert all(scenario_state.get_override(a) == (2, 0) for a in scenario_state.SCENARIO_STATES["NORMAL"])
observations.append({"requested": "NORMAL", "health": "GREEN", "all_seven_asset_states_reset": True})
